notes: Changing character used to leave the previous body standing in the same place as the new one. For a moment both were drawn on top of each other, together with the grey stand-in figure you begin as. The body you are leaving behind now goes the instant the new one arrives, so a change of character reads as a change rather than a pile-up.
This showed every time you came out of the character creator, and again on anything that rebuilds the body — which is exactly where the game most needs to look deliberate rather than half-finished.

The recipe gallery — the screen used behind the scenes to judge how the bodies look lined up beside each other — had the same fault: rebuilding it stacked a dead row behind the new one instead of replacing it. It now shows only the row it just built.
title: Changing character no longer leaves the old body standing inside the new one
